Scope: Unsigned package eligibility acquisition regression after the user decision for 7-Zip and ShareX

Results.UnsignedArtifactCase: A NotSigned artifact with a matching provider SHA-512 was accepted and recorded.
Results.IntegrityFailureCase: Altered bytes failed the provider digest check and were moved to rejected-artifact storage before success was recorded.
Results.PackageSpecificDecision: 7-Zip and ShareX remain eligible when NotSigned; their exact source/version and available digest checks still apply.

SideEffects.TemporaryFixtures: Pester used mocked HTTP, signatures, and local .local fixtures; no real publisher payload was used.

HostVmAccessRecheck.Result: Access to a CIM resource was not available to the client before VM/checkpoint inspection.

Resolved: PackageEvidence acquisition regression now verifies NotSigned remains eligible with a matching provider digest and digest mismatches still fail.
Deferred: Windows installer/lifecycle and target acceptance remain separate for packages not already accepted on Windows 11.
Partial: The 7-Zip and ShareX eligibility decision is implemented in policy and covered by the shared acquisition regression; this test does not itself provide their current payload or native acceptance.
